source.quote_free_summary: Contests must use a WSDC-approved Callback system and a computerized system meeting the Section 6 requirements, including a WSDC scoring report.

requirement: External authorization dependency only. WSDC publicly audits scoring systems against Section 6 and lists approved ones. DanceFlow is not listed, has not applied, and no approval is claimed or implied. No contact with WSDC is authorized.
interpretation_notes: Public page worldsdc.com/scoring-systems (retrieved 2026-11-24) describes the audit and lists approved systems for Jack and Jill only (the page is undated, so the list may be stale); the admission route is not public. Approval is distinct from algorithm correctness and from rule compliance.
decision_refs: OD-24 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A; retrospective audit PR #795)
